snippet.title: Expendabots - Exclusive Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.
